1.w: [“] Indeed at this my heart trembles, and it leaps from its place.

2.w: Listen closely to the quaking of His voice, and the rumbling from His mouth [that] comes forth.

3.w: Beneath all the heaven He unleashes it, and His lightning [is] over the edges of the earth.

4.w: After it, a voice roars; He thunders with the voice of His majesty, and He does not restrain them when His voice is heard.

5.w: God thunders with His voice wondrously; He does great [things] that we cannot know.

6.w: For to the snow He says, ‘Fall [on] the earth,’ and to the shower of rain, and to the shower, ‘[Be] the rains of His might.’

7.w: He seals up the hand of every man, for the knowing of His work [by] all men.

8.w: And the beast comes into [its] lair, and in its dens it shall dwell.

9.w: From [its] chamber the whirlwind comes, and the cold from the scattering winds.

10.w: From the breath of God, ice is given, and the breadth of the waters [is] in constraint.

11.w: Also with moisture He loads the thick cloud; His lightning scatters the cloud.

12.w: And it turns around, being turned [about] by His guidance, to do all of what He commands them above the face of the habitation of the earth.

13.w: If for the rod, if for His land, if in His loving devotion, He makes it find it.

14.w: Give ear to this, O Job; stand and consider the wonders of God.

15.w: Do you know [how] God does place upon them, and [how] He causes the light of His cloud to shine?

16.w: Do you know about the balancing of the cloud, the wonders of the One perfect in knowledge,

17.w: [you] whose garments [are] hot in the quieting of the earth from the south?

18.w: Have you beaten the skies with him, strong as a mirror of cast metal?

19.w: Make us know what we should say to Him; we cannot arrange from the face of the darkness.

20.w: Should it be told to Him that I would speak, If a man spoke that he would be swallowed up?

21.w: And now they cannot look at the light; it [is] bright in the clouds when the wind has passed over and cleansed them.

22.w: Gold comes from the north; upon God [is] a fearsome majesty.

23.w: Shaddai—we cannot find Him out! [He is] great [in] power and judgment, and abundant [in] righteousness, He does not oppress.

24.w: Therefore men fear Him; He does not regard any of the wise of heart.”
